cdf_version: Internal CDF version tracking. Do not modify manually.
w: Overall width of the generated power grid bounding box.
l: Overall length (height) of the generated power grid bounding box.
t_metal: Select the highest metal layer used in the power grid mesh. Vias will be automatically generated from the bottom metal up to this layer at intersections.
b_metal: Select the lowest (base) metal layer used in the power grid mesh.
t_metal_width: Width of the routing tracks (straps) on the top metal layer.
b_metal_width: Width of the routing tracks (straps) on the bottom metal layer.
n_cols: Number of vertical routing columns (straps) distributed across the grid width.
n_rows: Number of horizontal routing rows (straps) distributed across the grid length.
min_spacing: Read-only -- Minimum spacing between adjacent routing tracks (straps) on the same metal layer.
